candidates.title: A machine learning model identifies patients in need of autoimmune disease testing using electronic health records
candidates.scope_hint: ML on longitudinal EHR (161,584 individuals) identifying patients needing autoimmune disease testing; binary classification with external validation
candidates.out_of_scope_risk: Binary outcome is need-for-test rather than acute deterioration; arguably borderline acute-care

candidates.title: Evidence-driven spatiotemporal COVID-19 hospitalization prediction with Ising dynamics
candidates.scope_hint: HOIST Ising-dynamics deep learning predicting county-level COVID-19 hospitalization counts using insurance claims, census, hospital data
candidates.out_of_scope_risk: Outcome is count regression at county level not patient-level binary; likely OUT OF SCOPE

candidates.title: Predictors of the post-COVID condition following mild SARS-CoV-2 infection
candidates.scope_hint: Norwegian register data of 214,667 SARS-CoV-2 infected individuals predicting post-COVID condition >=3 months post-test
candidates.out_of_scope_risk: Outcome is post-COVID at >=3mo, not acute deterioration; descriptive risk factor analysis not full ML

candidates.title: Evaluation of pragmatic oxygenation measurement as a proxy for Covid-19 severity
candidates.scope_hint: Observational cohort of 39,765 hospitalised COVID-19 patients evaluating modified oxygenation index as predictor of mortality (binary)
candidates.out_of_scope_risk: Methodology paper on outcome measure; predictive modelling component is limited

candidates.title: High-throughput target trial emulation for Alzheimer’s disease drug repurposing with real-world data
candidates.scope_hint: Target trial emulation framework on real-world EHR (170M patients) for Alzheimer drug repurposing with confounding control
candidates.out_of_scope_risk: Causal inference on treatment effects, not predictive modeling; likely OUT OF SCOPE

candidates.title: Amino acid catabolite markers for early prognostication of pneumonia in patients with COVID-19
candidates.scope_hint: Serum metabolome of 83 COVID-19 patients identifying amino acid catabolite markers for early prognosis of severity
candidates.out_of_scope_risk: Small N omics-driven biomarker discovery; not retrospective EHR cohort ML

candidates.title: Quick model-based viscoelastic clot strength predictions from blood protein concentrations for cybermedical coagulation control
candidates.scope_hint: Personalized phenomenological models predicting TEG viscoelastic clot strength from blood protein concentrations for ICU/sepsis/surgery cohorts
candidates.out_of_scope_risk: Outputs are continuous TEG curves not binary; likely OUT OF SCOPE for binary prediction

candidates.title: Personalising intravenous to oral antibiotic switch decision making through fair interpretable machine learning
candidates.scope_hint: Interpretable ML on 10,362 ICU stays from MIMIC predicting IV-to-oral antibiotic switch (binary clinical decision) using routine clinical parameters
candidates.out_of_scope_risk: Binary endpoint is decision-support not deterioration; verify framed as binary classification

candidates.title: Data encoding for healthcare data democratization and information leakage prevention
candidates.scope_hint: Data encoding via random projection / quantum encoding for healthcare deep learning to prevent leakage; demonstrated on clinical models
candidates.out_of_scope_risk: Methods paper on privacy/leakage; relevant to MLGG leakage theme but not a clinical prediction cohort study

candidates.title: Unveiling unique clinical phenotypes of hip fracture patients and the temporal association with cardiovascular events
candidates.scope_hint: Latent class analysis on 78,417 hip fracture patients to identify subphenotypes and predict major adverse cardiovascular events; HK + UK cohorts
candidates.out_of_scope_risk: Survival/hazard ratio framing for some outcomes; LCA not standard prediction; verify binary endpoint

candidates.title: Acute and post-acute respiratory complications of SARS-CoV-2 infection: population-based cohort study in South Korea and Japan
candidates.scope_hint: Population-based propensity-matched cohort (Korean K-COV-N 2.3M + Japanese JMDC 3.1M) for SARS-CoV-2 acute respiratory complications
candidates.out_of_scope_risk: Risk-of-outcome epidemiology with propensity matching; not classic ML prediction model; borderline

candidates.title: GLP-1 receptor agonists’ impact on cardio-renal outcomes and mortality in T2D with acute kidney disease
candidates.scope_hint: Propensity-matched retrospective cohort (TriNetX, 165k AKD patients) on GLP-1 RAs vs none; outcomes mortality/MACE/MAKE
candidates.out_of_scope_risk: Causal inference / treatment effect study, not predictive ML; likely OUT OF SCOPE
